Title: Manoj and the Family

Cast

1. Manoj - 32 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Anjali - 55 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Vikram - 61 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Manoj stands on the battlefield. Anjali and Vikram stand near him.]

Manoj: "Let's do something fun today."

[An arrow strikes Manoj in the chest and he clutches the wound.]

Manoj: "Yes, of course."

[A sword slashes Manoj's arm and blood runs down to his wrist.]

Manoj: "Okay, Mother."

[Wounded, Manoj staggers and drops to one knee.]

Anjali (excited): "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj is hit in the leg and limps away bleeding.]

Vikram: "Anjali, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Anjali and Vikram stand near him.]

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Manoj staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Manoj: "Show me too!"

[Manoj walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Anjali: "Really?"

[Manoj wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Anjali: "That was fun!"

[Manoj takes a selfie with Mother.]

Manoj: "What next?"

[Manoj jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Manoj: "I'm ready!"

[Manoj dies in the fire.]

Vikram: "We have to be strong now."
